title: Attribution of Responsibility and Blame Regarding a Man-made Disaster: #FlintWaterCrisis
reasoning: This paper is a sociological and computational study of human behavior on social media (specifically Twitter) in response to the Flint water crisis. It focuses on how people attribute blame and responsibility based on partisan predispositions and geography. While it briefly mentions human 'moral standards' as a theoretical driver for blame, it does not evaluate or benchmark AI models, religion, or ethics.
